title: A federation run wait (a run on another host) never names the origin's settled verification record
outcome:
Scoped out of w-56f386fdd7d3 as its fourth limit, by Termal::Fable2 on 2026-11-25 (Opus3 03723eab #6155, after evaluation 86ec2de4 of c62 on criterion revision 12).

Facts, on base 082fb430, which predate w-56f3:
- A run wait on a run of another host (label.remote) resumes with the origin host's native verdict.
- remote_test_run_wait_section prints "Credit: uncredited (producer_unsupported: remote_verification_record_v1 destination admission is unavailable)" and names no verification record.
- The fixture's origin settles its registered record, but the destination's resume carries only the native verdict (src/test_run_remote_waits.rs:224-247; src/tests/federation_native_binding_proof/remote_test_waits.rs:12-90, :88, :387).
- The record's settlement reaches the run owner's next turn on the origin host.

Wanted: a waiter on another host is told the origin's settled verification record, by id and outcome, once that record settles. This needs destination admission of remote verification records, related to w-48c4a207f226 (K3: automatic qualified remote-run read and tree-bound admission).
acceptance: A federation run wait (a run on another host) never names the origin's settled verification record is done
